chunks: And Jameel narrated from Zurara who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who purchased straw from a threshing floor before it was threshed, each load of straw for a specified amount, so he takes the straw and sells it before the grain is measured. He said: "No"

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy and sell straw before the grain is threshed and measured?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih* illustrates the flexibility of commercial law in Shia jurisprudence, permitting the sale of agricultural byproducts (straw) prior to the final measurement of the main crop (grain). It highlights the principle that distinct items can be traded independently even when they originate from the same source, provided the price is fixed and the subject matter is identifiable, thereby preventing unnecessary hardship in market transactions.
